P0300.title: Random/multiple cylinder misfire
P0300.description: Check ignition system, fuel delivery, compression. Inspect plugs, coils, injectors.

P0301.title: Cylinder 1 misfire
P0301.description: Check cylinder 1 plug, coil, injector; compression test.

P0420.title: Catalyst system efficiency below threshold
P0420.description: Check catalytic converter and O2 sensors. May indicate failed cat or downstream O2.

P0171.title: System too lean (bank 1)
P0171.description: Check MAF, vacuum leaks, fuel pressure, O2 sensors.

P0700.title: Transmission control system malfunction
P0700.description: Read TCM codes for specific transmission fault. Check fluid level and condition.

P0505.title: Idle control system malfunction
P0505.description: Check idle air control valve, throttle body, vacuum leaks.
